name: Los Cerritos Center
description: Los Cerritos Center is a premier shopping destination in Southern California, featuring over 180 stores and restaurants across 1.2 million square feet. The enclosed regional mall offers an extensive mix of national retailers, department store anchors including Macy's and JCPenney, and diverse dining options. Conveniently located at the intersection of the 91 and 605 freeways, it serves the vibrant communities of Los Angeles and Orange Counties.
demographics: Serves affluent suburban communities in Los Angeles and Orange Counties with diverse, family-oriented demographics including high Asian-American population concentration in the Cerritos area.
summary: A major regional shopping mall in Southern California offering 180+ stores, department store anchors, and convenient freeway access for the LA/Orange County area.
